name: tino
description: Manage your Tino hosting, VPS, domains, DNS, invoices and support tickets through the Tino MCP server with OAuth consent.

interface.longDescription: Manage your Tino account in plain language: list and inspect hosting and VPS services, start, stop or reboot a VPS, check and renew domains, change nameservers, edit DNS records, review and pay invoices from account credit, and handle support tickets. Tools that change data are marked as write operations; review and confirm the intended change according to your application settings. Access is limited to the permissions you approve when you sign in to Tino.
defaultPrompt: List my Tino services and their renewal dates.
Which nameservers does my domain use?
